presets.name: USDC-style reserves (30 Sep 2026)
presets.source: Circle monthly USDC examination report as of 30 Sep 2026 (dated 26 Oct 2026): $73.879bn USDC in circulation, $73.957bn reserves at fair value. Circle Reserve Fund (USDXX) $62.467bn (T-bills $25.36bn, overnight Treasury repo $36.65bn, cash $1.00bn, settlement -$0.55bn); cash at regulated financial institutions $9.502bn; directly held T-bills $1.758bn; the remaining $0.229bn of the $11.489bn 'other reserve assets' is not itemised and is treated as cash. Fund weighted average maturity 17 days (BlackRock factsheet, Sep 2026). The banks holding the cash are not named; the yield and the maturity of the directly held bills are assumptions.
presets.description: Almost entirely a government money market fund (T-bills and overnight repo) plus bank cash. Very short duration: the risk here is bank exposure and how fast the fund can turn into cash, not interest rates.

redemption.note: Circle Mint: institutions only, approval-gated and jurisdiction-dependent. No official minimum found; standard redemptions assumed free (an Express rate may apply).

presets.name: USDT-style reserves (Q2 2026)
presets.source: BDO Advisory Services (Milan) ISAE 3000R report on Tether International's financial figures as of 30 Jun 2026, signed 31 Jul 2026: total assets $187.751bn, total liabilities $183.642bn (tokens issued $183.622bn). T-bills $114.961bn (weighted average maturity under 90 days), overnight reverse repo $18.626bn, term reverse repo (under 90 days) $6.993bn, precious metals $18.838bn, bitcoin $5.802bn, secured loans $13.454bn, other investments $5.245bn, public equities $3.761bn, cash and deposits $0.040bn, non-US T-bills $0.022bn, corporate bonds $0.009bn. Yields and the exact bill and repo tenors are assumptions. This is the latest Tether report published as at 30 Oct 2026.
presets.description: Mostly T-bills and repo, but about a quarter sits in gold, bitcoin, secured loans and other investments. Over-collateralised by about 2%, which is the buffer that absorbs shocks before the peg is threatened.

redemption.note: tether.to/fees (Oct 2026): KYC-verified accounts only (approval at Tether's discretion, $150 verification fee); minimum redemption $100,000; fee the greater of $1,000 or 0.1%.

presets.name: XSGD-style SGD stablecoin (illustrative reserves)
presets.source: Supply is real: about S$12.69m (US$9.9m at 0.7815 USD/SGD) of XSGD outstanding on 30 Oct 2026 (DefiLlama). The reserve split is NOT published in a form we could verify (StraitsX's monthly attestations sit behind an email form), so the mix below is an illustration of a reserve built to the MAS single-currency stablecoin rules: cash at two Singapore banks plus MAS bills of 3 months or less, with a 1% buffer. Amounts are in US$ equivalent; rate shocks should be read as SGD rate moves.
presets.description: A Singapore-dollar coin of the kind a Singapore payments firm would hold for local settlement. Tiny next to USDT and USDC, so price impact is negligible: the real risks are concentration in two local banks and how fast the bills can be sold.

redemption.note: StraitsX holds an MAS Major Payment Institution licence. The MAS SCS framework requires par redemption within 5 business days; StraitsX's own redemption minimum and fee were not found.

presets.name: SVB-style duration mismatch (hypothetical)
presets.source: Hypothetical portfolio for teaching. It mirrors the mistake Silicon Valley Bank made: long-dated Treasuries bought when yields were low, funded by money that can leave overnight.
presets.description: 60% in 10-year notes bought at a 1.8% yield. Fully backed on day 0, but a rate rise quietly erodes the reserves and a run forces the losses to be realised.

presets.name: USDC on 10 Mar 2023, SVB weekend (reconstructed)
presets.source: Circle disclosed on 10 Mar 2023 that $3.3bn of roughly $40bn of USDC reserves was held at Silicon Valley Bank (CNBC, 11 Mar 2023). The split between other bank cash and the Circle Reserve Fund is approximate.
presets.description: Reconstruction for teaching: the $3.3bn at Silicon Valley Bank is public, but the split of the other reserves is our estimate, not Circle's actual book. About a third of the bank cash was at the bank that failed.

redemption.note: Circle Mint redemptions were paused over the weekend of 11-12 Mar 2023 and resumed on Monday 13 Mar.

presets.name: Narrow benchmark: cash + short bills (hypothetical)
presets.source: Hypothetical best-practice portfolio built only from assets permitted under both the GENIUS Act and the MAS single-currency stablecoin framework, with a 2% capital buffer.
presets.description: Cash spread across banks, overnight repo and bills under 93 days. Use it as the yardstick the other portfolios are compared against.
